headline: Heat hold off the Knicks at the Garden
dek: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, and Miami held on at the Garden.
three: A career high on the glass, and he passed 22,000 career points.
Heat up 16 at the half, then held on after the Knicks took a 92–91 lead
